extra.message: The 'username' query parameter is concatenated directly into a Jinja2 template string passed to Environment.from_string() and then rendered. An attacker can supply a value like '{{ 7*7 }}' or '{{ config.__class__.__init__.__globals__["os"].popen("id").read() }}' to achieve Server-Side Template Injection, leading to remote code execution.

The rendered template output containing unsanitized user input is returned as HTMLResponse(content=output). Any HTML/JavaScript in the username will be rendered in the response, resulting in Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS).
